scripts.release:docker: set -e; out=$(node scripts/release/build.mjs); tgz=${out##*Release: }; ctx=$(mktemp -d); cp "$tgz" "$ctx/buddi.tgz"; cp scripts/release/docker/Dockerfile "$ctx/Dockerfile"; docker build -t buddi-trial "$ctx"; rm -rf "$ctx"; echo "Image buddi-trial built from $tgz"
scripts.test: node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && pnpm -r build && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm -r test && pnpm check:generic
scripts.dev:refresh: pnpm -r build && node packages/cli/dist/main.js migrate && node packages/cli/dist/main.js service restart
scripts.dev:install: pnpm -r build && pnpm run link && node packages/cli/dist/main.js migrate && node packages/cli/dist/main.js service install
